entities.summary: John Lee Smith was the 32nd lieutenant governor of Texas from 1943 to 1947. A member of the Democratic Party, he represented the 24th district in the Texas Senate from 1941 to 1942 and was a vocal opponent of Texas labor unions during his tenure.
